## Instructions

### 1. Start with the Inspection Records

The ASW Helper tool runs a local program that has synchronized with the Monero server. This is where we start documentation.

- Click "Run" then "Selection List"
- From here you can sort by any column you want, utilize filters, and show/hide columns.
- You have three ways of accessing the records:
  - Clicking the "Check" or "Fail" box
  - Clicking the "More Info" link
  - Double clicking on the item in question
- After clicking the proper box or link, the full documentation page appears. We'll learn more about this later, but for now, click the Link or "C1" button or simply press enter to
